2 15-05-2024

Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned APP for the State and learned counsel for the informant.
2. The petitioners are apprehending their arrest in connection with Kadamkuan P.S. Case No.
602/2023 for the offence under sections 498A/34 of the IPC and  of the D.P. Act lodged on 18.09.2023 by the informant, Puja Kumari.
3. Since the informant has already appeared, with the consent of the parties, let the matter go before the Mediation Center where the couple will appear on 24.06.2024 and a report be submitted on 26.07.2024.
